completion_data.completion_summary: Removed 6 obsolete OC_ path prefixes and replaced 2 .language field checks with .task_type in .opencode/extensions/lean/skills/ SKILL.md files, restoring correctness and alignment with core skill routing.

memory_candidates.content: When fixing legacy path prefixes across skill files, grep both the target tree AND the parallel .claude/ tree to confirm which already has fixes. This prevents redundant work and reveals scope-creep opportunities to document separately.

Lean skills use `padded_num` variable in metadata/git paths but never declare it. This is a latent bug that will break postflight when the variable is undefined. Fix: derive padded_num from task_number with zero-padding (e.g., printf '%03d').
